공통: One continuous shot, no cuts. The camera is locked off exactly as in the start frame: no zoom, no pan, no tilt, no shake. Keep the exact handmade needle-felt miniature look of the start frame in every frame: fine wool felt fibres, visible stitches, matte felt and wool; every object keeps its shape, size and colour and never turns into a realistic thing. MONGLE is the coral-pink felt blob. At rest its face is only its two glossy black bead eyes: no nose and no mouth. When its feeling changes, its whole face changes to show that feeling, as written in ACTION, always in needle-felt: the eyes may grow bigger and rounder, squeeze shut into short curved dark stitched lines, curve into happy arcs or droop under little felt lids; a small simple felt mouth may open, smile, pout or wobble; blush, a felt sweat drop or a felt teardrop may appear. When the feeling passes, the mouth and the drops go away and the face returns to rest. Open eyes always stay glossy black beads: no white sclera, no coloured iris, no sparkling cartoon eyes, no eyelashes, no human teeth or lips. Mongle has NO arms, NO legs, NO hands and NO neck, ever: no limbs ever grow, nothing ever sticks out of its body. It moves only by tilting, squashing, stretching and bouncing its whole soft dome body. LOOK: the same light and colours as the start frame, unchanged to the last frame. Apart from Mongle's own expression, nothing new appears that is not in the start frame. If MONGLE is not in the start frame it never comes in. MONGLE does not blink. No speed lines, no motion lines, no cartoon effects, no steam, no smoke. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos. No sound.

ACTION: From 0 to 1.0 s the owner sets the plate of golden felt dumplings down on the back half of the table and lets go. From 1.0 to 2.0 s he straightens up a little with a big proud warm grin, his left hand dropping to his side while he moves his RIGHT felt hand down and forward and lays it flat, palm down, on the front of the table just left of the wallet, exactly as in the end frame; it rests there until the end. From 1.0 to 2.0 s Mongle's bead eyes follow the plate. At about 2.2 s Mongle only tilts its dome a little toward the owner and looks up at him, puzzled, eyes a little rounder. Mongle stays sitting flat on the table the whole time: its scalloped hem always rests on the table top, it never stands up and nothing grows under it. The wallet, the bowl and the chopsticks never move.

클립.prompt: Medium shot of the restaurant owner on the far side of the table from the start frame, Mongle at the right edge. ACTION: From 0 to 1.2 s the owner sets the white felt plate of sweet-and-sour pork down the last finger's width onto the table beside the dumplings. From 1.2 to 2.4 s he stands up straight, beaming with pride, and dips his head in a single proud nod. From 2.4 to 4.0 s he holds one open palm toward the new plate, smiling at Mongle. At 1.0 s Mongle tips back a little further in surprise and stays tipped back, its two round glossy bead eyes wide open and worried until the last frame; Mongle never smiles and never closes its eyes in this shot. The wallet stays flat in place; nothing moves unless a hand touches it.

Very close on Mongle from the start frame, the open yellow felt wallet and a few gold felt coins on the table at the left. ACTION: From 0 to 1.0 s Mongle's whole soft dome leans a little to the left, then a little to the right, nervously; its two eyes stay small solid glossy black beads the whole time, with no white around them, and its two pale-blue felt sweat drops stay on its side. From 1.0 to 2.2 s Mongle squashes forward and bumps the open wallet with the front of its scalloped hem, and three more small gold felt coins spill out of the wallet and slide flat along the table to the left; the coins stay flat on the table and never jump or fly. From 2.2 to 3.0 s Mongle sinks back, its small wavy felt mouth staying wavy and worried; Mongle does not smile.

Wide high view of the whole crowded table from the start frame. ACTION: From 0 to 1.5 s the owner, holding the big white felt bowl of red jjamppong in both hands, lowers it the last little bit into the only empty space left on the table. From 1.5 to 2.5 s he lets go and takes half a step back, both hands open, beaming at the full table. From 2.5 to 4.0 s little Mongle between the bowls slowly sinks lower and squashes down, its bead eyes growing wider. No dish moves unless the owner's hands touch it.

Very close on Mongle from the start frame, its eyes squeezed shut, the small heap of gold felt coins and the empty open wallet in front of it. ACTION: From 0 to 2.2 s Mongle's whole soft dome lurches forward three times in short bursts, and each time the front edge of its scalloped hem bumps the coin heap and the wallet a little further to the left; the coins slide flat along the table and never lift. Nothing ever sticks out of Mongle's body: no arm, no hand, no flap, no tongue; only the scalloped hem touches the coins. Mongle's eyes stay squeezed shut as two short felt arcs and its small open felt mouth stays a panicked round 'O'. From 2.2 to 3.0 s Mongle stays squashed forward, panting, its body gently rising and falling.

Medium close on the owner from the start frame, Mongle at the right edge. ACTION: From 0 to 1.2 s the owner breaks into a warm laugh, his shoulders bouncing, his eyes squeezed into happy curves. From 1.2 to 3.0 s his raised right hand waves palm-out twice in a friendly 'no, no' while his left hand, flat on the yellow wallet, slowly slides the wallet and the heap of gold felt coins to the right across the table until they rest against the front of Mongle's scalloped hem; the coins slide flat and stay together under his hand. From 3.0 to 4.0 s he lifts his hand away, smiles and gives Mongle one nod. Mongle gazes up at him with round bead eyes and no mouth, tips its dome slightly at 2.0 s, and from 3.0 s its bead eyes grow bigger and rounder in surprise.

Close on Mongle from the start frame with its sparkling felt star eyes. ACTION: From 0 to 1.5 s Mongle breathes out one long relieved sigh: its dome slowly sinks flatter and a little wider, its rosy cheeks glowing, its small happy open felt mouth growing wider. From 1.5 to 3.0 s it does one small happy bounce and settles. The closed yellow wallet and the coins in front of it stay still.

Medium shot from the start frame: Mongle with one empty white felt plate resting flat on top of its head, empty felt bowls on the table, the owner at the left edge. ACTION: From 0 to 1.5 s Mongle stretches up a little taller and leans its whole dome toward the owner on the left, so the plate resting on its head tips toward him like an offering; Mongle keeps its happy curved eyes and cheeky smile. From 1.5 to 3.0 s it bounces twice, small and happy, without leaving the table. From 3.0 to 4.0 s it stays leaning toward the owner. The plate never leaves the top of Mongle's head and nothing holds it: nothing ever sticks out of Mongle's body, no arm, no hand, no flap. The owner keeps smiling at Mongle, his hands resting on the table.

Very close on the owner from the start frame, holding a small plain cream felt paper slip. ACTION: From 0 to 0.8 s his smile turns stiff and frozen and he blinks once, slowly; the felt sweat drop stays at his temple. From 0.8 to 2.2 s his right hand pushes the small cream paper slip forward toward the camera. From 2.2 to 3.0 s he holds it out with an awkward fixed grin, eyebrows slightly raised.

From 1.3 to 2.2 s the empty plate on its head slowly slips a little to one side and stops, never leaving its head. From 2.2 to 3.0 s Mongle goes a shade paler and a single small pale-blue felt sweat drop appears on its side; the shocked open mouth stays. Nothing ever grows out of Mongle's body.
